hints.title: Zero Sum Game Interval Choice
hints.text: In this alternating game, a player picking from ends maximizes their net score difference over the opponent.

hints.title: Recurrence on Subarray Boundaries
hints.text: The best net gain from subarray [i, j] is max(nums[i] - score(i + 1, j), nums[j] - score(i, j - 1)). Player 1 wins if overall score >= 0.

hints.title: Space-Optimized 1D Dynamic Programming
hints.text: Initialize dp as copy of nums. For length from 2 to n, and i from n - length down to 0, let j = i + length - 1, and update dp[j] = max(nums[i] - dp[j], nums[j] - dp[j - 1]). Return dp[n - 1] >= 0.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of elements in nums
complexity.notes: Optimal dynamic programming solution running in quadratic O(N^2) time with O(N) space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unmemoized minimax tree branches exponentially into O(2^N) states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Rolling 1D array reduces space from O(N^2) down to O(N).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should note that ties (score difference 0) award the victory to Player 1.
